description: HMS qgraph vertex index, Euclidean metric, SIFT-1M (ann-benchmarks sift-128-euclidean) in tuning mode: 2,000 train vectors held out as queries (every 500th), exact Euclidean truth over the other 998,000; the test queries were not read. Apple M4 (10 cores), build on all cores, single-threaded queries one at a time, 3 repeats per row.
caveat: Other benchmark processes shared the machine (load_1m 20-73 during timing, recorded per row). Timed runs held the shared bench lock, which serializes timers but not other CPU use, so QPS and build seconds are noisy and not comparable across files; recall and mean_exact_evals_per_query are deterministic. Configuration choices use recall and estimates per query.
findings: 4-bit vertex codes: recall stops at 0.990 (re-rank 128) on every degree/build_ef; it rises only with the re-rank size (0.929/0.976/0.990 at 32/64/128, 0.9968 at 512), so true neighbours are misordered by the traversal estimate.
8-bit vertex codes reach 0.9999 (d64e500) and 0.99 at about 2,000 estimates per query; chosen for the harness (d64e500, re-rank 32 and 64).
A random rotation (FWHT) of the centred vectors before coding raised the 4-bit ceiling only from 0.9900 to 0.9916 (8-bit: 0.9998 to 0.9999) and was not kept.
probe_note: Probes reuse one cached d64e500 graph; one repeat each, timing not used. The rotated probes ran a build with the rotation experiment, which is not in the committed code.

holdout.note: Tuning run: queries are train vectors held out of the index (every n/N-th row), truth is exact (cosine or Euclidean, per the metric) over the rest; the test set was not read.

notes: Single-threaded, one query at a time; query rotation and quantization are inside the timer, normalization is outside (as for the other systems).
qps_single_thread is the median of the repeats; recall is from the first repeat (search is deterministic).

Edge index: each expanded vertex is scored exactly; mean_exact_evals_per_query counts those plus the upper-layer descent. Vertex index: it counts every code estimate (descent, traversal) plus the re-rank scores.
